svg.title: OCULUS trial: food left in the stomach when people skipped one GLP-1 dose vs kept taking it
svg.desc: Share of patients whose stomach contents blocked or cut short the procedure. All patients: 3.1% (1 of 32) who held one dose vs 25.0% (7 of 28) who kept taking it. Upper endoscopy only: 5.0% (1 of 20) vs 46.7% (7 of 15). Endoscopy plus colonoscopy, with clear liquids the day before: 0 of 12 vs 0 of 13.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skip one dose, or keep taking it? The only randomized test
